clips.title: The story
paras: Jorgen sends trusted operatives across Stormwind with a sealed note for Elling Trias. The delivery carries the search for the missing diplomat from the Valley of Heroes to Trias' Cheese in the Trade District.

After the first inquiries into the diplomat's disappearance, Jorgen asks trusted operatives to keep silent and carry a sealed note across the city. It is meant for Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District, not a barracks or magistrate's office. The handoff avoids ordinary guard channels as concern over the missing diplomat reaches beyond the palace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this here note to Elling Trias. Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will.
I'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, friend: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut.
Ya can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. Good luck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm sorry, a letter for me? Well, I'll be... Not often you get a delivery that's not a crate or barrel when all you do is work. Let's see what this is about.
You look a little tense, you okay, friend?
